policy.name: public-virus-v1
policy.identity_rule: Sample organism must name the virus or one of the accepted sample-level typed attributes must name it; host organism, title, experiment text and study-level statements do not satisfy this gate.

fields: Attributes: source name, cell line, tissue, treatment
biosample_records.finding: All 15 records identify Homo sapiens; HCoV-229E occurs only in the treatment attribute for 12 samples, not in an accepted public-virus-v1 identity attribute.

paper.methods_evidence: The Methods state HCoV-229E VR740 at MOI 0.01, MRC-5 cells, RNA extraction at 0, 6, 24, 48, 72 and 96 hours post-infection, and three biological repeats at each time point. The Methods do not establish independent culture preparations for each repeat. The GEO series design and deposited sample set list only 0-72 hours; the 96-hour discrepancy remains unresolved.
paper.study_exposure_evidence: The Results describe HCoV-229E-infected MRC-5 cells and viral titers measured by qPCR in cells and supernatants. This is study-level evidence, not run-level sequence confirmation.

evidence_categories.ARCHIVE_DECLARED_VIRUS_IDENTITY: Whether the exact SRA/BioSample record provides HCoV-229E in an accepted organism or typed identity attribute.
evidence_categories.STUDY_REPORTED_VIRUS_EXPOSURE: Whether accession-linked GEO sample annotation and the publication support the stated experimental exposure.
evidence_categories.SEQUENCE_CONFIRMED_VIRUS_PRESENCE: Whether sequence data from that exact sample have been inspected and virus presence confirmed.

recommendation.decision: Consider only as a separately named, human-reviewed exploratory evidence category after a formal policy change. It must not imply archive-declared identity, sequence presence, acquisition eligibility, or a biological finding.
additional_review_before_pilot: Independent reviewer confirms all 15 accession links and per-sample condition text against live GEO, SRA, BioSample and ENA records.
Resolve the discrepancy between GEO Untreated and the paper's 0-hour post-infection wording before assigning any 0-hour exposure/control role.
Obtain exact evidence that three replicate labels represent independently prepared biological units; until then independence remains UNKNOWN.
Approve a formal policy amendment specifying source hierarchy, change/withdrawal handling, dual review, control semantics and downstream uncertainty labels.
Re-run the unchanged identity and acquisition preflight after any future approved policy amendment; do not infer sequence-confirmed presence without sequence analysis.
